title: Japanese-Style Yaki-Iwai Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful Japanese-inspired appetizer featuring marinated chicken and vegetables, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.
Add the chicken, red bell pepper, onion, and mushroom to the marinade.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush with warmed almond oil during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve immediately and garnish with warm almonds.
Let cook for 3 minutes between serving and serving again.
